pages.title: Recycler
pages.text: The Recycler turns waste into useful resources. It needs no energy — just feed it items using a $(bold)hopper$() and collect the output from the other side with another hopper. Processing takes about 2 seconds per item.

pages.title: Rotten Food → Biomass
pages.text: When food expires in your inventory it becomes $(bold)Rotten Food$(). Drop that rotten food into the Recycler and it becomes $(bold)Biomass$(). Biomass works just like bonemeal — use it to grow your crops faster. Grow food, eat food, rot scraps, grow more food!

pages.title: Old Tools → Materials
pages.text: Tools and armour can be recycled back into raw materials. $(bold)Plastic tools and armour$() give back a Plastic Sheet. $(bold)Steel tools$() give back a Steel Ingot. Vanilla tools return their base material too!

pages.title: Failure Rate
pages.text: Recycling isn't perfect — there's a $(bold)30% chance$() that the recycler fails and the item is lost. This represents real-world recycling, where not everything can always be recovered. Right-click the recycler to inspect what's inside.
Use hoppers to automate the input and output.
